title: Cap. VIII: The penalty's reach conceded; original vice stands between
pass_a_gloss: Placeus answers by granting the whole of that argument as stated. Rhetorical challenge: who among us has ever denied that Adam's fall's penalty has spread through everyone? The real dispute is narrower: between the penalty and Adam's fall there stands intervening original vice, and the penalty is owed to that vice as its proximate debtor.
pass_b_english: I grant the whole argument. Which of us ever denied that the penalty of Adam's fall has pervaded all? We contend only this: between that penalty and Adam's fall, original vice has intervened, and to that vice the penalty is owed proximately.
source_text: Concedo totum arg. Quis enim nostrum unquam negavit, lapsus Adae poenam in omnes esse pervagatam? Tantum contendimus, inter eam & lapsum Adae intervenisse vitium originale cui proxime poena debetur.

lemmas.gloss: to which the penalty is owed proximately

choices.decision: original vice has intervened between fall and penalty
